arrival_rules.order: CSV original data-record order simulates arrivals, not verified chronological order.
arrival_rules.identity: One-based arrival index; duplicate configurations count as separate arrivals.
arrival_rules.input: update(configuration, outcomes): separate dictionaries; unknown or misplaced keys rejected.
arrival_rules.missing: Omitted keys, None, and blank strings mean missing; no objective imputation. Numeric strings normalize to finite floats; booleans and non-finite values rejected.
arrival_rules.statistics: Welford incremental mean and M2 separately per objective, using observed values only. Sample variance M2/(n-1) and sample standard deviation are null for n<2; mean null for n=0.
arrival_rules.ties: Exact equality after float normalization; earliest arrival retained as best. best_tie_count counts all arrivals attaining the current best, including repeated configurations.
arrival_rules.causality: Each update reads only its arguments and current accumulators; no batch summaries, rescans, fitting, predictions, repeated tests, or stopping rules.
arrival_rules.invalid: Invalid arrivals raise ValueError without changing state. Finite inputs causing non-finite moment arithmetic are also rejected.
arrival_rules.snapshots: Returned snapshots are detached copies. Evaluator stores constant-size accumulators and best configurations; replay retains O(arrivals) history.

limitations: Row order is a simulation, not verified time order; arrivals are not asserted independent or randomized.
Observed best values describe received outcomes only; no optimality, future-performance, uncertainty, significance, or stopping guarantee.
Missing outcomes may be selective; each objective uses its own observed subset.
Recorded metric scales and directions only; formulas, physical units, compute costs, and theoretical ranges are unspecified.
Float arithmetic can round near ties and running moments; extreme magnitudes overflowing moment arithmetic are rejected.
Configuration validation reuses Step 2 normalization; absent configuration fields are permitted, with no invented hyperparameter domains.
No overall objective score, prediction, or Step 3 inferential procedure is applied during streaming.
